body_markdown:
Reservoir’s Hans Zimmer contributed to the 2026 Mercury Prize Album of the Year, *THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE.* by Raye, which features Zimmer’s collab “Click Clack Symphony.”


Upon release, the single reached #11 in the UK, with the album landing at #1 in the UK and #11 on the Billboard 200. Stereogum also praised “the song”Click Clack Symphony.” for its “grand symphonic arrangement,” and Billboard included the song on their list of the “50 Best Songs of 2026 So Far,” describing the track as a “perfect thesis statement” for Raye’s album.
